prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the carved stone galleries of Angkor Wat with sunlit sandstone paving, standard-height doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Romanian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, an intense, proud expression, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (an iron barrel-shaped weight, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a bronze ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop with a heavy rough gold a ship's anchor hanging at its end, and a single gold hair ornament. Extremely long round nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her body carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme gold platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Mexican man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, glass-skin makeup with a faint shimmer on the cheekbones, smooth warm light-brown skin, a confident smirk, soft rose-gold hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a lead square-sided cowbell, an iron round bell, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a lead teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop with a heavy rough silver a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre hanging at its end, and two to three gold anklets. Extremely long square nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A very tall, slim, long-limbed man with a runway build. Straight shoulders, a flat lean chest, a flat defined stomach, slender strong arms and very long legs, lightly muscled and elegant, with visible collarbones and a narrow waist. His head stays in correct proportion to his long frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His body carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, koi sakura formations in CRIMSON and PINK, extreme high-gloss oil finish. It is fused to his own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white platform loafers with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
